meta_title: PB & Sons Gardening | Garden Services Southampton
meta_description: PB & Sons Gardening in Southampton offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local, reliable, friendly service. Call us today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we bring your outdoor space back to life.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a complete redesign, or one-off tidying, we've got your garden covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or monthly upkeep tailored to your garden's needs. Hedge trimming, grass cutting, weeding, and seasonal tidying to keep everything looking fresh.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Transform tired outdoor space into a usable, beautiful garden. We design layouts, source plants, and handle all construction — patios, raised beds, pathways included.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Struggling with an untamed jungle? We clear, dispose of waste responsibly, and leave you with a blank canvas ready for what's next.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Safe pruning, felling, and removal of trees and large shrubs. We're experienced and insured, and we'll grind stumps if needed.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Maintenance
services.desc: Pressure washing, moss and algae removal, and repair of loose slabs. We restore your hard landscaping to like-new condition.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Spring bedding, autumn bulbs, and perennial borders designed for year-round colour. We source quality plants and handle all prep and aftercare.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own — honest pricing, real craftsmanship, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: PB & Sons Gardening was founded over 15 years ago when Pete decided there had to be a better way — friendly, reliable gardeners who actually listen to what you want. We've grown from a one-man operation to a tight-knit team, but we've never lost that personal touch. Every job gets the same care and attention, whether it's a monthly tidy or a full garden redesign.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we do what we say we'll do, on time and within budget. We're based right here in Botley, we know Southampton's soil and climate inside out, and we're not afraid to give honest advice — even if it means suggesting a smaller project that suits your needs better. Word of mouth is everything to us, and we're proud that most of our work comes from recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant blokes. Our garden was a complete mess — about 15 years of neglect! Pete and the lads cleared it all, designed a lovely new layout with raised beds and a patio, and it's transformed the whole feel of the garden. Very fair prices too. Couldn't recommend them more.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: I've had PB & Sons round monthly for maintenance for three years now. Reliable, friendly, and they always tidy up properly after themselves. They know exactly what needs doing and don't oversell you unnecessary work. That's rare.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Had a massive overgrown hedge and two ugly stumps in the garden. Pete came round, quoted straightaway, and got the work done in a day. Professional, safe, and the garden looks twice the size now. Cheers, lads.
reviews.author: David C.
